title: Germany Tracker Update — May 25, 2026
summary: AfD hit a record 28% in the May 19 Forsa poll — its widest lead over CDU/CSU (22%) ever recorded, driven by voter frustration with the governing coalition's reform delays. Germany's Foreign Minister Wadephul traveled to the NATO Helsingborg ministerial (May 21-22) and proposed a €40B multilateral Ukraine financing mechanism for the July Ankara Summit; Germany also signaled support for NATO's 5% of GDP defense target. The EU-US trade deal implemented May 20 averted threatened 25% tariffs on German cars, a major win for Merz's economic agenda. Police arrested five teenagers linked to the far-right 'Last Defense Wave' terror network on May 21, accused of arson attacks in Brandenburg and Thuringia. Foreign Minister Wadephul was added to the political tracker; AfD KPI updated to 28%; new NATO 5% spending claim added.

title: Germany Tracker Update — May 16, 2026
summary: Germany and Ukraine signed the landmark 'Brave Germany' €4B defense package in Kyiv (May 11), including joint production of deep-strike drones with 1,500 km range and 5,000 AI-enabled strike drones. Rheinmetall announced domestic cruise missile production at Unterlüß to fill the US Tomahawk gap. The CDU-SPD coalition agreed a reform roadmap with a July 15 deadline covering pensions, taxes, and healthcare after a six-hour crisis summit. Germany and the EU rejected Putin's proposal to use ex-Chancellor Schröder as a Ukraine mediator, with EU chief Kallas calling him effectively a Russian lobbyist. The Forsa May 11 poll showed AfD at 27% to CDU/CSU's 22%, projecting the AfD as the largest party in a hypothetical Bundestag.

summary: CDU-SPD Coalition Agrees Reform Roadmap With July 15 Deadline After Six-Hour Crisis Meeting. In a runoff election for District Administrator of Barnim in Brandenburg, SPD candidate Daniel Kurth won decisively with 66.1% of the vote, defeating the AfD challenger who received 33.9%.

title: Germany: History & Governance Tracker Update — Mon May 11, 2026
summary: EU foreign ministers meeting in Brussels unanimously rejected Putin's proposal to use former German Chancellor Gerhard Schröder as a mediator in future Ukraine security talks. German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius traveled to Kyiv and signed a landmark joint defense agreement branded the 'Brave Germany' arms program. Germany's largest arms manufacturer Rheinmetall announced plans to begin producing cruise missiles domestically at its main facility in Unterlüß, Lower Saxony. The May 11 Forsa poll showed the AfD at 27%, CDU/CSU at 22%, Greens at 15%, SPD at 12%, Die Linke at 11%, and FDP at 4% — below the 5% Bundestag threshold.

title: Germany Tracker Update — May 09, 2026
summary: Chancellor Merz marks one year in office with Germany's lowest first-year approval rating (15% Forsa) as the AfD overtakes CDU in polls for the first time (28% vs 24% INSA). Trump's order withdrawing 5,000 US troops from Germany — retaliation for Merz criticizing US Middle East strategy — threatens the transatlantic alliance alongside further threatened troop cuts and 25% EU car tariffs. SIPRI confirmed Germany reached 2.3% of GDP in defense spending in 2026 ($114B), Europe's highest in 36 years, while the CDU-SPD coalition publicly clashes over welfare cuts at May Day rallies. Merz has ruled out snap elections or an AfD-backed minority government.
